u2: Describe a time when you had to learn something really difficult. What helped you most, and what would you do differently now?
Is intelligence something we are born with or something we develop? Give reasons and examples.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of cramming for an exam compared with studying a little every day?
u4: Talk about a piece of technology that has changed your daily life. How would your life be different without it?
Some people say that technology makes life more complicated, not easier. How far do you agree?
Describe a big change in your life. How did you adapt to it?
u6: Describe a job you would love to do in the future. What would a typical working day be like?
Is it better to work in the public or the private sector? Discuss the advantages of each.
How do you manage your time when you have a lot to do? Give an example from the last few weeks.
u8: Describe a memorable journey you have made. Where were you going and what happened on the way?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of commuting by public transport compared with driving?
Do you think people today travel too much? Explain why or why not.
u12: Talk about a time when luck played an important part in your life.
Are you a superstitious person? Do you think superstitions have any basis?
What can ordinary people do to protect the environment? Which actions are the most effective?
u14: How do you usually decide what to spend your money on and what to save?
Do you think people are paid fairly for the jobs they do? Give examples.
Describe an occasion when you spent a lot of money on something. Was it worth it?
u16: Describe a building you particularly like or dislike in your town. Why?
Would you rather live in a big city or in the countryside? Compare the two.
What materials are used to build houses where you live, and are they a good choice?
u18: Describe a time you were really angry or upset. How did you deal with it?
How important is it for people to look after their health? What are the main obstacles?
Talk about a time when you had to be patient. How did you cope?
u20: What can governments do to reduce crime? Which measures do you think work best?
Should young people be required to do some kind of community service? Discuss.
Talk about a person in a position of power you admire or do not admire, and explain why.
u22: Describe a work of art, a book or a film that made a strong impression on you.
Is it important for governments to spend money on the arts? Give reasons.
Talk about something you own that is of high quality. Why is it special?
u24: Describe a person who has had a big influence on you. How are you similar and different?
What qualities are most important in a close friend? Explain your choices.
Do you think family relationships are changing nowadays? In what ways?
u26: Talk about your favourite way of spending free time and why it appeals to you.
Is it better to have a few strong hobbies or to try many different activities?
How important is it to have a good work-life balance? What do you do to achieve it?

u2.p: Some people believe that university education is the only route to a successful career. Write an essay discussing the importance of different kinds of learning. Give reasons and examples. (220-260 words)

u4.p: Technology is changing the way we live faster than ever. Write an essay assessing whether these changes are mostly positive or negative for society. (220-260 words)

u6.p: Your company wants to introduce flexible working hours. Write a report for the manager evaluating the advantages and disadvantages and making recommendations. (220-260 words)

u8.p: Write an article for a travel magazine called "A journey I will never forget", describing a trip and explaining why it was memorable. (220-260 words)

u12.p: Natural disasters seem to be happening more often. Write an essay on what governments and individuals can do to reduce their effects. (220-260 words)

u14.p: A local charity has asked you to write a proposal on how to raise money for a new community centre. Suggest at least two ideas and justify them. (220-260 words)

u16.p: Write a letter to the town council complaining about plans to demolish an old building in your area and suggesting an alternative. (220-260 words)

u18.p: Write an article for a student magazine on how to cope with exam stress and stay healthy. (220-260 words)

u20.p: Some people say harsher punishments are the best way to reduce crime. Write an essay giving your opinion. (220-260 words)

u22.p: Write a review of a book, film or exhibition you have recently seen, saying whether you would recommend it. (220-260 words)

u24.p: Family and friends both play a major role in our lives. Write an essay discussing which has more influence on a person. (220-260 words)

u26.p: You recently attended a leisure event that was disappointing. Write a formal letter to the organisers explaining the problems and asking for a refund. (220-260 words)
